changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Update mirror_products IDs from numeric format to PRD000001 format
changeSet.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE id_mapping AS SELECT id as old_id, 'PRD' || LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(id AS INTEGER))::TEXT, 6, '0') as new_id FROM mirror_products;
UPDATE mirror_products mp SET id_new = im.new_id FROM id_mapping im WHERE mp.id = im.old_id;
UPDATE lab_grown_diamonds lgd SET mirror_product_id = im.new_id FROM id_mapping im WHERE lgd.mirror_product_id = im.old_id;
UPDATE mirror_products mp SET designer_id = CAST(im.new_id AS BIGINT) FROM id_mapping im WHERE mp.designer_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.designer_id::TEXT = im.old_id;

DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'lab_grown_diamonds' AND column_name = 'mirror_product_id') THEN ALTER TABLE lab_grown_diamonds ADD CONSTRAINT fk_lab_grown_diamonds_mirror_product FOREIGN KEY (mirror_product_id) REFERENCES mirror_products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; END IF; END $$;
